You stayed on the last train… but who's driving it?
Some of you pressed red. So you step off into the tunnel. Don't touch the third rail, it carries about six hundred volts.
Then footsteps behind you… and you turn around.
Most of you pressed white. The doors close, and the hunter stays outside. Then the train speeds up, with nobody driving.
Trains have a dead man's switch. If the driver lets go, it brakes on its own… this one doesn't.
Rule three says never enter the cab. You go in anyway, rip the tape off the lever, and pull the brake.
It stops in the dark. Then footsteps in the next car… the hunter got on board.
Ten seconds. Run for the exit… or lock yourself in the cab? Comment one or two.
